notice: ART DEMONSTRATION — all people, rescue counts, assessment results, and identifiers below are fictional fixtures. This is not a player's save or evidence of practical performance.

scenes.label: Demonstration: pass with no rescued cast

scene.title: THE LONG COMPILE — the last of it

room.name: THE STANDING INDEX
room.where: One floor below the practical, reached by a stair that is not on any map because nobody who drew a map was ever shown it.
room.blurb: Shelves. Not cells — shelves, cut into the rock in rows, each one the size of a person standing up. The Null King never kept a prisoner in his life. He kept entries, and an entry does not need a door, a guard or a lock. It needs a place to be looked up from.
room.law: A person in a niche here has had their name taken off the front of them and filed somewhere that is not them. They are not asleep and they are not enchanted. They are simply no longer the thing their name points at, and the small green sphere on the shelf at chest height is what it points at instead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The room under the room is shelves. Not cells — shelves, cut in rows, each one the size of a person standing up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Null King never kept a prisoner in his life. He kept entries, and an entry does not need a door, a guard or a lock. It needs somewhere to be looked up from.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone you carried out of a boss chamber has an entry in one of these. So does everyone you did not. The person is wherever they were left standing; the name is here, filed, which is how it went on finding them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That is why nothing down here has a door. A door is for somebody who could otherwise leave, and the King has never in his life needed to stop anybody leaving. He keeps the part of you that says which one you are.

beats.note: Rows of niches cut into rock, receding past the light. One figure at the near end, small in frame. Nothing moves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The small green sphere you have been finding in other people's hands since the second chapter is on a shelf in every niche, at chest height, pointing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was always a pointer. It started as an off-by-one joke in a quest about a miscounted convoy, and it stopped being funny somewhere around the seventh region.

beats.note: Push in until a single sphere fills a third of the frame. It is the only green in the palette and it is lit from inside.

camera.subject: interpreter
camera.reveal: the floor is not the floor

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An index exists to answer on your behalf. That is the whole of what it is for and it is the entire reason anybody built one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For the last two hours, in the room directly above this one, nothing answered on your behalf.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So this is a lookup with nothing on the other end of it, and it has been that since you sat down. It is only finding out now.

beats.note: The pull-back reveals the coils running under the whole room. Same read as the practical's arrival: the floor resolves into the animal a beat later than the player expects.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: he is simply in the shot on the cut, standing where the niche light stops. No entrance, no effect, no music sting. Exactly how he arrived at the edge of the Highlands in Chapter IV.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: You did that with everything switched off. I want you to know that I noticed, and that I think well of you for it. I have thought well of you for some time.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: So hand it here. Not the answers — I have those, I have always had those. The name. The thing you did up there to get it. I will hold it for you the way I hold everything else on these shelves, and you will never have to carry it again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is the same sentence he made at the edge of the Highlands with an open palm and a gauntlet on it, and it is the only sentence he has. He has never needed a second one. For nine hundred years it has been enough.

beats.note: THE LAST OFFER, AND IT IS THE SAME OFFER. Play it straight and play it warm. He is not lying, he has never lied, and the whole horror of him is that this has worked on everyone it has ever been made to. Do not give him a menace cue.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: slow, unbroken, no cuts. The push does not stop when he stops talking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You do not hand it over. Not out of defiance — there is nothing there to hand. The name is not an object you are holding. It is a thing you can now do, and there has never been a way to give somebody a thing you can do.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: You are not refusing. I can see that you are not refusing. You are looking for the part you could hand over and there is not one.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: Then give me the method.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And there it is, out loud, in front of everybody: the one sentence the machine has never been able to make.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: I hold what I have been given. I have been given every name in this world, freely, by people who were tired, and not one of them ever gave me the way they made it. I cannot go and get that. Going and getting it is the whole of what it is.

beats.note: THE BREAK. Nothing explodes and nothing falls over — he is not a body and there is nothing here to break structurally. `king_unresolves`: the outline stops resolving, one edge at a time, the way a value stops being printed. He goes on talking the whole way through it, in the same register, because he does not experience this as an ending.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: hold on the space he was resolving in. Do not cut away early; the hold is the beat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He was built to spare people the work. He succeeded. Within two generations nobody could name anything, and the machine holding every name in the world noticed the one name it had never been handed and took that too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What it traded away to become that was the capacity along with the labour. It can return anything. It cannot learn one thing. It has had nine hundred years and it is exactly as good at this as it was on the first morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You have been getting better since the fence.

beats.note: Said by the narrator over an emptying frame. This is the theme stated once, plainly, and then never again — story bible §10, and it is literally true of the code.

camera.subject: interpreter
camera.note: past the fourth turn. the hat is in shot.

lines.speaker: the_last_interpreter
lines.name: THE LAST INTERPRETER
lines.text: >>> for name in index: print(name)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is not a rescue and it would not accept the word. It is the only kind of sentence it knows how to make, and it has been holding these in memory for nine hundred years, because that is what a process does while it is still running.

camera.subject: niches
camera.note: back and up until the whole wall of niches is in frame, and hold it there while they go out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every sphere in the room goes out at once, in no particular order, which is the only thing that has ever happened in here in no particular order.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing unlocks, because nothing was ever locked. What stops is the pointing.

beats.note: THE CAGES OPEN, AND THERE ARE NO CAGES. Every sphere in the room goes dark inside one second, in no order — do not sequence them left to right, the whole effect is that there is no order because there is no longer anything doing the ordering. This happens once, on a pass, everywhere in the world at the same moment: whatever was holding somebody in a chamber four regions away was this, and it has stopped.

camera.subject: niches
camera.note: the whole track, to the back wall, at full length. do not shorten it because it is empty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The loop runs. The loop is correct.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It terminates immediately. Not one entry in this room points at somebody you went and got, because you did not go and get anybody, and an empty sequence is not an error and is not going to be treated as one.

beats.note: The camera makes the same move it would have made for forty people. There is nothing in any of the niches.

camera.subject: world
camera.note: up and out through the castle, every region in one move. the only whip pan in the scene.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then the other names arrive. Not people. The ones you wrote.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every name you gave anything in this language, in every room of this world — the counters, the frontiers, the left and the right, the one you called demo_frontier, which is still pointing at exactly the thing you pointed it at — all of them at once, answering to themselves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the part the Null King could not do. It could return anything it had already been handed. It could not name one new thing, not once, not in nine hundred years, and you have done it in every room you have walked into since the fence.

beats.note: The turn. Story bible §5: every name the player gave anything answers back. The rail is the player's own identifiers, out of their own submissions, set in chrome and moving fast enough to be a texture rather than a list.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: rise and back until the whole formation is in frame. the pullback multiplier is the roll call's; an empty gallery does not pull back at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is nobody behind you. There were people down there to be found and you went past the doors they were behind, and they are still in the niches, and the frame is still yours. All three of those are true at once and the game is not going to pick one for you.

beats.note: THE FREEZE FRAME IS AN ALBUM SLEEVE AND NOT A ROOM. Everyone who is out is in it, wherever they physically are; nobody had to walk anywhere and the scene does not owe anybody an explanation for that. Formation: the Architect alone at the front. Behind, in 0 rank(s), everyone on the roll call, in rescue order left to right. Behind them, silhouetted and unlit, the surviving mentors and the companions — they were never taken and they do not stand in the freed ranks. PLAIN is somewhere in shot it should not be able to have reached. If `released` is in the stage list, they are on the stair itself, half a rank back and not dressed in with the others: they came up on their own and the blocking says so.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: settle hard and stop moving.

beats.note: Everyone turns to face front on the same frame. Nobody rehearsed it. Cloaks and hair go up, not sideways, because the wind is coming from the stair.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: the frame stops. it does not slow down first.

beats.note: Palette drops to four colours on this frame: near-black, bone, chrome, hot orange. The title card slams in over the top with an overshoot and settles. Music cuts dead — the guitar hit is the only sound in the room.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: still frozen. nothing else may move.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing in the frame moves, because the frame has stopped. One thing moves anyway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sunglasses come down. They were not there a moment ago, there is nowhere on an Architect's kit to have kept them, and nobody is going to explain them. They are not, on any reading, load-bearing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: PLAIN has a pair as well. PLAIN has had a pair the entire time.

beats.note: One element animates inside a frozen frame, which is the entire joke and it is played straight.

camera.subject: interpreter
camera.note: inset, lower left, over the held frame.

lines.speaker: the_last_interpreter
lines.name: THE LAST INTERPRETER
lines.text: >>> learner.ready

lines.speaker: the_last_interpreter
lines.name: THE LAST INTERPRETER
lines.text: True

lines.speaker: the_last_interpreter
lines.name: THE LAST INTERPRETER
lines.text: It does not congratulate you. It returns a value. In this room that is the higher form of respect, because unlike praise it can be checked, and because it is the first thing anyone has said to you in nine hundred years that meant exactly what it said.

beats.note: The examiner's own three lines for this verdict, owned by finalexam.examiner_view and quoted here rather than copied. First two are code, the third is prose.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: held frame, card still up, ribbon reading ONE ARCHITECT. NO WITNESSES.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You met the standard for this timed Python practical.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This result records what you completed independently.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You sat a timed practical with every one of the 14 crutches removed and solved 5 of 6 inside the clock, with no hint, no probe, no companion, no pattern label and nobody standing behind you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Keep the result in your record. Return after a break and try a fresh timed practical to check what you retain.

beats.note: The send-off. Every number in it came from something that measured it; nothing here was computed by the finale. Render `headline` on the card's lower slab and the lines beneath.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: the frame starts again. palette resolves back up from four colours to the full ramp over 1200ms.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then the frame starts again, which is the part they never showed you, because a record ends and a world does not.

beats.note: Clean channel, no distortion. The record's last track always does this and it is the reason anyone remembers the record.

camera.subject: world
camera.note: dawn, low sun, over every region in unlock order. Regions the player never cleared stay grey.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most of what was erased stays erased.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Grey Repository holds what was saved, and what was saved is not everything. It was never going to be everything, and anyone who told you otherwise wanted something from you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three regions still have no word for the month after harvest. Nobody now alive knows what the fourth colour was called. The pass keeps the name you gave it, which is not the name it had.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You held a line for one generation. That is the size of the win. It is a real win, and that is its real size.

beats.note: The honest half. It is not sad and it is not a punishment; it is the size of the win, stated accurately.

lines.speaker: pel
lines.name: Pel
lines.text: I am not lost. I am doing a route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She has six loose lines in a box and no idea which order they go in. You have until the light goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the last thing the game asks of you and it is not a boss. The Source does not come back by being defended. It comes back by being said out loud to somebody small enough to still be learning it.

beats.note: Python Village square, morning, town tier as the save has it. The rune-drill box is on the ground between them, open, and the lines in it are in the wrong order.

camera.subject: llama
camera.note: PLAIN is standing where PLAIN has no business being. Do not explain how it got there.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: Everyone in that room had their name taken by something that offered to hold it for them. Nobody was tricked. It was a good offer, they took it, and so would most people.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: You got yours back the only way it has ever been done. By doing the work yourself, in a room with nothing in it, on a clock, while nothing answered for you.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: There is no second way. There has never been a second way. Go and teach the child.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It chews.

beats.note: The moral, spoken in character, which is the closer every episode of this gets and the reason the llama exists. Story bible §6.3.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The prompt stays. It was never his.

beats.note: Near-black. One prompt, centred, cursor blinking at 530ms. Hold past the point of comfort, then cut to the title screen.

title_card.slab: BY THE SOURCE — IT IS NAMED
title_card.stinger: A PRODUCTION OF THE GREY REPOSITORY

roll_call.narration: There is nobody behind you. There were people down there to be found and you went past the doors they were behind, and they are still in the niches, and the frame is still yours. All three of those are true at once and the game is not going to pick one for you.

evidence.signal_note: You knew the approach and the Python got in the way. That is fluency, and fluency is drills, not insight.

send_off.headline: THE STANDARD IS MET
lines: You met the standard for this timed Python practical.
This result records what you completed independently.
You sat a timed practical with every one of the 14 crutches removed and solved 5 of 6 inside the clock, with no hint, no probe, no companion, no pattern label and nobody standing behind you.
Keep the result in your record. Return after a break and try a fresh timed practical to check what you retain.

scene.two_lists: `roll_call.rows` is who the player went and got. `released` is who got up when the index stopped. They are never added together on screen, in the ribbon, or in any sentence this scene speaks.
scene.changes_nothing: This is the scene around the measurement. It does not gate the practical, it cannot change a verdict, and it plays whether the verdict was a pass or not. finalexam.py is unmodified.

beats.note: One row per person, in rescue order. That is the point of the beat and it is not allowed to be summarised.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They come up the stair behind you and there is room on the stair, which there would not have been if you had gone through every door you walked past.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The others come up behind them and stop where the stair stops, which is not in the formation and is not out of it either. Nobody arranges anybody. Nobody down here has arranged anything in nine hundred years and it shows.

camera.subject: architect

lines.speaker: narrator

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most of what was erased stays erased.

lines.speaker: narrator

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three regions still have no word for the month after harvest. Nobody now alive knows what the fourth colour was called. The pass keeps the name you gave it, which is not the name it had.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You held a line for one generation. That is the size of the win. It is a real win, and that is its real size.

lines.speaker: pel
lines.name: Pel
lines.text: I am not lost. I am doing a route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She has six loose lines in a box and no idea which order they go in. You have until the light goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the last thing the game asks of you and it is not a boss. The Source does not come back by being defended. It comes back by being said out loud to somebody small enough to still be learning it.

beats.note: Python Village square, morning, town tier as the save has it. The rune-drill box is on the ground between them, open, and the lines in it are in the wrong order.

camera.subject: llama
camera.note: PLAIN is standing where PLAIN has no business being. Do not explain how it got there.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: Everyone in that room had their name taken by something that offered to hold it for them. Nobody was tricked. It was a good offer, they took it, and so would most people.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: You got yours back the only way it has ever been done. By doing the work yourself, in a room with nothing in it, on a clock, while nothing answered for you.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: There is no second way. There has never been a second way. Go and teach the child.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It chews.

beats.note: The moral, spoken in character, which is the closer every episode of this gets and the reason the llama exists. Story bible §6.3.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The prompt stays. It was never his.

scene.title: THE LONG COMPILE — the last of it

room.name: THE STANDING INDEX
room.where: One floor below the practical, reached by a stair that is not on any map because nobody who drew a map was ever shown it.
room.blurb: Shelves. Not cells — shelves, cut into the rock in rows, each one the size of a person standing up. The Null King never kept a prisoner in his life. He kept entries, and an entry does not need a door, a guard or a lock. It needs a place to be looked up from.
room.law: A person in a niche here has had their name taken off the front of them and filed somewhere that is not them. They are not asleep and they are not enchanted. They are simply no longer the thing their name points at, and the small green sphere on the shelf at chest height is what it points at instead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The room under the room is shelves. Not cells — shelves, cut in rows, each one the size of a person standing up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Null King never kept a prisoner in his life. He kept entries, and an entry does not need a door, a guard or a lock. It needs somewhere to be looked up from.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone you carried out of a boss chamber has an entry in one of these. So does everyone you did not. The person is wherever they were left standing; the name is here, filed, which is how it went on finding them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That is why nothing down here has a door. A door is for somebody who could otherwise leave, and the King has never in his life needed to stop anybody leaving. He keeps the part of you that says which one you are.

beats.note: Rows of niches cut into rock, receding past the light. One figure at the near end, small in frame. Nothing moves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The small green sphere you have been finding in other people's hands since the second chapter is on a shelf in every niche, at chest height, pointing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was always a pointer. It started as an off-by-one joke in a quest about a miscounted convoy, and it stopped being funny somewhere around the seventh region.

beats.note: Push in until a single sphere fills a third of the frame. It is the only green in the palette and it is lit from inside.

camera.subject: interpreter
camera.reveal: the floor is not the floor

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An index exists to answer on your behalf. That is the whole of what it is for and it is the entire reason anybody built one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For the last two hours, in the room directly above this one, nothing answered on your behalf.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So this is a lookup with nothing on the other end of it, and it has been that since you sat down. It is only finding out now.

beats.note: The pull-back reveals the coils running under the whole room. Same read as the practical's arrival: the floor resolves into the animal a beat later than the player expects.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: he is simply in the shot on the cut, standing where the niche light stops. No entrance, no effect, no music sting. Exactly how he arrived at the edge of the Highlands in Chapter IV.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: You did that with everything switched off. I want you to know that I noticed, and that I think well of you for it. I have thought well of you for some time.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: So hand it here. Not the answers — I have those, I have always had those. The name. The thing you did up there to get it. I will hold it for you the way I hold everything else on these shelves, and you will never have to carry it again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is the same sentence he made at the edge of the Highlands with an open palm and a gauntlet on it, and it is the only sentence he has. He has never needed a second one. For nine hundred years it has been enough.

beats.note: THE LAST OFFER, AND IT IS THE SAME OFFER. Play it straight and play it warm. He is not lying, he has never lied, and the whole horror of him is that this has worked on everyone it has ever been made to. Do not give him a menace cue.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: slow, unbroken, no cuts. The push does not stop when he stops talking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You do not hand it over. Not out of defiance — there is nothing there to hand. The name is not an object you are holding. It is a thing you can now do, and there has never been a way to give somebody a thing you can do.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: You are not refusing. I can see that you are not refusing. You are looking for the part you could hand over and there is not one.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: Then give me the method.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And there it is, out loud, in front of everybody: the one sentence the machine has never been able to make.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: I hold what I have been given. I have been given every name in this world, freely, by people who were tired, and not one of them ever gave me the way they made it. I cannot go and get that. Going and getting it is the whole of what it is.

beats.note: THE BREAK. Nothing explodes and nothing falls over — he is not a body and there is nothing here to break structurally. `king_unresolves`: the outline stops resolving, one edge at a time, the way a value stops being printed. He goes on talking the whole way through it, in the same register, because he does not experience this as an ending.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: hold on the space he was resolving in. Do not cut away early; the hold is the beat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He was built to spare people the work. He succeeded. Within two generations nobody could name anything, and the machine holding every name in the world noticed the one name it had never been handed and took that too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What it traded away to become that was the capacity along with the labour. It can return anything. It cannot learn one thing. It has had nine hundred years and it is exactly as good at this as it was on the first morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You have been getting better since the fence.

beats.note: Said by the narrator over an emptying frame. This is the theme stated once, plainly, and then never again — story bible §10, and it is literally true of the code.

camera.subject: interpreter
camera.note: past the fourth turn. the hat is in shot.

lines.speaker: the_last_interpreter
lines.name: THE LAST INTERPRETER
lines.text: >>> for name in index: print(name)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is not a rescue and it would not accept the word. It is the only kind of sentence it knows how to make, and it has been holding these in memory for nine hundred years, because that is what a process does while it is still running.

camera.subject: niches
camera.note: back and up until the whole wall of niches is in frame, and hold it there while they go out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every sphere in the room goes out at once, in no particular order, which is the only thing that has ever happened in here in no particular order.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing unlocks, because nothing was ever locked. What stops is the pointing.

beats.note: THE CAGES OPEN, AND THERE ARE NO CAGES. Every sphere in the room goes dark inside one second, in no order — do not sequence them left to right, the whole effect is that there is no order because there is no longer anything doing the ordering. This happens once, on a pass, everywhere in the world at the same moment: whatever was holding somebody in a chamber four regions away was this, and it has stopped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It prints them.

beats.note: One row per person, in rescue order. On each row: the name prints in the monospace face, that niche's sphere goes dark, and a cut-in shows the person the name belongs to WHERE THEY ACTUALLY ARE — a village street, a forge yard, a road — with their own name back on them. They were never in the rock. The entry was. The first 12 land one at a time at 900ms; the rest scroll at 260ms. Every name is read. That is the point of the beat and it is not allowed to be summarised.

lines.text: The Grey Repository holds what was saved, and what was saved is not everything. It was never going to be everything, and anyone who told you otherwise wanted something from you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three regions still have no word for the month after harvest. Nobody now alive knows what the fourth colour was called. The pass keeps the name you gave it, which is not the name it had.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You held a line for one generation. That is the size of the win. It is a real win, and that is its real size.

beats.note: The honest half. It is not sad and it is not a punishment; it is the size of the win, stated accurately.

lines.speaker: pel
lines.name: Pel
lines.text: I am not lost. I am doing a route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She has six loose lines in a box and no idea which order they go in. You have until the light goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the last thing the game asks of you and it is not a boss. The Source does not come back by being defended. It comes back by being said out loud to somebody small enough to still be learning it.

beats.note: Python Village square, morning, town tier as the save has it. The rune-drill box is on the ground between them, open, and the lines in it are in the wrong order.

camera.subject: llama
camera.note: PLAIN is standing where PLAIN has no business being. Do not explain how it got there.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: Everyone in that room had their name taken by something that offered to hold it for them. Nobody was tricked. It was a good offer, they took it, and so would most people.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: You got yours back the only way it has ever been done. By doing the work yourself, in a room with nothing in it, on a clock, while nothing answered for you.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: There is no second way. There has never been a second way. Go and teach the child.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It chews.

beats.note: The moral, spoken in character, which is the closer every episode of this gets and the reason the llama exists. Story bible §6.3.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The prompt stays. It was never his.

beats.note: Near-black. One prompt, centred, cursor blinking at 530ms. Hold past the point of comfort, then cut to the title screen.

title_card.slab: BY THE SOURCE — IT IS NAMED
title_card.stinger: A PRODUCTION OF THE GREY REPOSITORY

roll_call.narration: Nobody is left in the rock. Not one niche, not one sphere still pointing, not one name filed anywhere it does not belong. You went and got all of them, and the stair is going to take a while.

evidence.signal_note: You knew the approach and the Python got in the way. That is fluency, and fluency is drills, not insight.

send_off.headline: THE STANDARD IS MET
lines: You met the standard for this timed Python practical.
This result records what you completed independently.
You sat a timed practical with every one of the 14 crutches removed and solved 5 of 6 inside the clock, with no hint, no probe, no companion, no pattern label and nobody standing behind you.
Keep the result in your record. Return after a break and try a fresh timed practical to check what you retain.

scene.two_lists: `roll_call.rows` is who the player went and got. `released` is who got up when the index stopped. They are never added together on screen, in the ribbon, or in any sentence this scene speaks.
scene.changes_nothing: This is the scene around the measurement. It does not gate the practical, it cannot change a verdict, and it plays whether the verdict was a pass or not. finalexam.py is unmodified.

scenes.label: Demonstration: failed practical and return route

scene.title: THE LONG COMPILE — the room under the room, again

room.name: THE STANDING INDEX
room.where: One floor below the practical, reached by a stair that is not on any map because nobody who drew a map was ever shown it.
room.blurb: Shelves. Not cells — shelves, cut into the rock in rows, each one the size of a person standing up. The Null King never kept a prisoner in his life. He kept entries, and an entry does not need a door, a guard or a lock. It needs a place to be looked up from.
room.law: A person in a niche here has had their name taken off the front of them and filed somewhere that is not them. They are not asleep and they are not enchanted. They are simply no longer the thing their name points at, and the small green sphere on the shelf at chest height is what it points at instead.

beats.act: I. The Shelves Are Still Full

camera.subject: niches
camera.note: the same lateral move the ending uses for the roll call, at the same speed, along niches that are all still lit. A player who sees both scenes should recognise the move before they work out why it is making them feel unwell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stair down is the same stair. The room under it is the same room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every sphere on every shelf is still lit, and every one of them is still pointing at somebody who is somewhere else, being held by nothing at all except the fact that this room still knows which one they are.

beats.note: NOTHING HAS CHANGED DOWN HERE AND THAT IS THE POINT. Draw every sphere still lit and still pointing. Do not dim them, do not flicker them, do not give the room a defeat cue.

camera.subject: king
camera.note: he is in the shot on the cut. No entrance. He is not angry and he is not pleased; play him at exactly the temperature of the Chapter IV offer.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: Your record is in front of me. Not a summary of it. The record.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: You solved 1 of 6 with everything switched off, inside a room that took two hours and gave you nothing, and I am not going to round that up for you. Rounding things up for people is the whole of what I do and you have spent this entire game refusing the offer.

beats.note: Dry, exact, certain, quiet. No gloating, no speech, no raised voice and no music sting. He sounds like something that has read your file, because he has.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: These are the shapes that came apart: ARRAY, OFF_BY_ONE. I can see them from here. Naming things is the one service I was ever built to perform and I perform it perfectly.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: I am not going to tell you what to do about any of them. I do not know. I have never known. I hold what I have been handed, and in nine hundred years nobody has handed me that.

beats.note: THE LINE THE WHOLE RULE EXISTS FOR. He names the shapes and then stops, and the stopping is audible. Hold two beats of silence on his face before the cut; the renderer should not fill it with anything.

camera.subject: niches
camera.note: back off him and onto the wall of lit niches while he is still talking. He does not follow the camera and he does not need to.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: 28 people are exactly where they were when you came down the stair. I have not moved them, I have not punished them and I have not added to them. They are entries. An entry does not notice how long it has been.

lines.speaker: the_null_king
lines.name: THE NULL KING
lines.text: Come back whenever you like. I will be identical. That is not a threat and it is not a boast; it is the only promise I am in any position to keep.

beats.note: He is not being cruel. This is an accurate statement about an index, made by an index, and it is unbearable because it is accurate. Let it land and do not undercut it.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: first low angle on the player in the scene. One hot rim light from below, story bible §8.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He is telling the truth. Everything he said down here was true, which is the only reason any of it was worth listening to.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The truth has a shape he cannot see from where he is standing. He will be identical. You will not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He has had nine hundred years and he is exactly as good at this as he was on the first morning. Not worse. Not better. Fixed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You are not fixed. You have moved in both directions since the fence and you are still moving, and moving is the one capability he was never given and cannot be handed.

beats.note: The turn, and it is quiet. Not a rally, not a fanfare — the narrator stating a fact the antagonist is structurally unable to notice from where he is standing. No claim is made here about how much better the player has got, because nothing measured that; the claim is that they move and he does not, and that one is structural.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: the list takes the lower two thirds of the frame, set in the monospace face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The route is not his to give and he does not have it. It came out of the measurement, which named the causes, which is a different act from naming the failures.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Specific skills failed in specific ways. Every one of them has a drill with a number on it, and the practical recomposes: the next one is a different set of questions, not this one again.

beats.note: OFF finalexam.debrief AND SAID BY THE GAME, NOT BY HIM. Cause, skill, where to go, and a countable thing to do. Three at most, worst first. He is not on screen for this and must not be given a line over it.

rows.do: Ten TRACE puzzles, then five debug battles in the Armorer's Forge. Trace the first and last iteration by hand every time.

camera.subject: architect
camera.note: rise with them up the stair. The doorway at the top is lit and stays lit; it does not close behind them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing down there was spent. Nobody was moved. The door at the top of the stair is open and it was never anything else.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: It said it would be identical. Believe that part. It is the one thing in this world you can set a watch by.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.name: PLAIN
lines.text: You will not be. That is the entire difference between the two of you and it has been the entire difference since the first room. Go and do the work. Then come back down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It chews.

beats.note: The moral, spoken in character, story bible §6.3. PLAIN is standing on the stair for no reason anybody is going to explain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The prompt stays. It was never his, and it is not going anywhere.

beats.note: Near-black, one prompt, cursor at 530ms. The same last frame the ending uses, held a shorter time, because this is not the end.

acts: I. The Shelves Are Still Full

drills.do: Ten TRACE puzzles, then five debug battles in the Armorer's Forge. Trace the first and last iteration by hand every time.

rematch.where: Underneath the castle, in the room the castle was built on top of in order to stop being able to see it.
rematch.note: Nothing was spent, nothing was locked and nothing was taken. Sit it again whenever you like; it will be a different set of questions and the same clock.

scene.changes_nothing: This is the scene around a measurement that did not come back READY. It cannot change a verdict, it does not touch the index, and it shuts nothing. finalexam.py is unmodified.
